Such bids to be publicly opened and read at such time and place on said day for the purchase of all, but not less than all, of the County's $70,000,000 General Obligation Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1997 (the

February 12, 1997 may be postponed upon no less than twenty- four hours notice given prior to the time bids are to be received and as communicated by the County through the Munifacts News Wire. If such a postponement occurs, a public sale will be held at the hour and place and on such date as communicated via the Munifacts News Wire upon forty-eight hours notice. The Bonds will be dated February 1, 1997 ANDWILLMATURE ON February 1, in the years 2001 through 2017, inclusive. The Bonds are callable on February 1, 2004 and thereafter as provided in the Detailed Official Notice of Sale. No bid will be considered for the Bonds for less than ninety eight and one half percent (98 1/2%) of par plus accrued interest or more than one hundred and two percent (102%) of par plus accrued interest, and the rate or rates bid for the Bonds shall not exceed seven percent (7%) per annum. Unless all the bids for the Bonds are rejected, the Bonds will be awarded by the County Executive to the bidder whose bid complies with the Detailed Official Notice of Sale and results in the lowest true interest rate on the Bonds. One bond certificate for each maturity will be issued to and registered in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York and immobilized in its custody at the expense of the County. The approving opinion of Robertson, Ingram and Overbey, Knoxville,

Tennessee, will be furnished at the expense of the County.
